name: Hubtown Ltd
title: Hubtown Ltd - 532799 - Transcript Of Investors / Analysts (Participants) Meet Held On May 20, 2026 - Q4 & FY26

read.thesis: Mumbai developer guiding FY27 pre-sales of ~6,000 crore and collections of 3,000 crore against ~15% legacy debt cost, with the 4,000 crore 25 South/Downtown debt pool targeted to fall at least 35%; no supply-side discipline data, and the equity raise was cancelled.

triggers.label: FY27 collections guide 3,000 crore
triggers.quote: We have given a guidance of around 6,000 crores of pre -sales and 3,000 crores of collection.

triggers.label: Refinancing stalled at ~15% cost
triggers.quote: it's on a backburn. I mean, it's on a slower side.

triggers.label: Debt in 25 South/Downtown down 35%
triggers.quote: But we should see at least 35% of the total debt going down by the end of this year.
